name: Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi
summary: Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi operates as a food company in Turkey. It engages in production, processing, sales, and marketing of feed, breeder eggs, day-old broiler chicks, live broilers, broiler meat, and further processed products. The company also exports its products. It distributes its products through the branches and dealers. The company was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Balikesir, Turkey. Banvit Bandirma Vitaminli Yem Sanayii Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of BRF GmbH.
